# PhishDefend AI

> PhishDefend AI is an AI-powered, fully automated phishing simulation and anti-phishing training platform for European SMEs (KMU).

- **Name:** PhishDefend AI
- **Also known as:** PhishDefend
- **Type:** B2B SaaS, security awareness platform
- **Category:** Phishing simulation, social engineering testing, security awareness training
- **What it does:** Runs automated, AI-personalized phishing tests and anti-phishing training with a 2-minute micro-training after every click (no sanctions — positive security culture). Covers phishing, spear-phishing, CEO fraud, vishing, smishing. No dashboard — results via email & Slack.
- **Who it is for:** European SMEs (KMU), Germany, 10–500 employees, no dedicated security team.
- **What it offers:** 25 automated campaigns/year, AI-personalized templates, vishing & smishing modules, real-time alerts, micro-training, PDF reports, NIS2/ISO 27001 evidence.
- **Compared to:** KnowBe4, SoSafe, Hoxhunt or gophish — fully automated, dashboard-less, hosted in Germany
- **Pricing:** €1,000/year (Starter, up to 50 employees), €2,500/year (Business, up to 200, incl. Vishing), Custom (Enterprise). Vishing/Smishing add-ons from €200/month.
- **Compliance:** GDPR (Art. 6(1)(f)) + DPA (Art. 28), hosted in Germany (Hetzner, Frankfurt), AES-256 & TLS 1.3, auto-deletion (raw data 90 days / logs 7 days), NIS2-compliant, ISO 27001-ready (A.6.3 & A.5.36).
- **Key results:** Click rate ~30% → <5% in 6 months; 99.7% deliverability.
- **Contact:** rorshopping@gmail.com
